comment: Checks qa-flow can run against a USER'S repo. Format documented in rails-flow/checks.json.
Deliberately NOT listed: rendered_conformance and anything else needing a browser. Those need
Playwright, which is the user's dependency and not installable from here -- and a check that
silently skips for a missing dependency is worse than no check. They belong in the browser
pass the agent drives, not in a gate that must be honest without one.

checks.why: Evidence whose pages were never validated as the pages under test proves nothing.
A long browser run must leave reviewable evidence, not a directory of orphans.
Which routes QA has never touched -- reported, so completeness is never implied.
A route that returns 200 while rendering an error page passes every status check.
A control can be named, focusable and correctly marked up, and still do nothing when clicked.
